veranderings.voor: om te drink en om kos te maak
veranderings.na: om te drink, om kos te maak
veranderings.rede: Three purposes strung together with 'en ... en' read woodenly; a list comma with one final 'en' is the natural form and saves a word.

veranderings.voor: Hulle werk by klinieke en by hospitale en party ry
veranderings.na: Hulle werk by klinieke en by hospitale, en party ry
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Hulle werk' and 'party ry'), so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.blok: Nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
veranderings.voor: maar almal kom nie ewe maklik daaraan nie
veranderings.na: maar nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
veranderings.rede: 'almal kom nie' can be read as 'nobody gets it easily'; putting 'nie' before 'almal' gives the intended 'not everyone' and matches the block heading.

veranderings.blok: Nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses with their own subject and verb ('Party gemeenskappe kry' and 'ander sukkel'), so a comma goes before it.

veranderings.blok: Nie almal kom ewe maklik daaraan nie
veranderings.voor: Daar is ook huise in 'n stad sonder 'n kraan en plase met elektrisiteit en genoeg water.
veranderings.na: Party huise in 'n stad het geen kraan nie, en party plase het elektrisiteit en genoeg water.
veranderings.rede: As written, 'sonder 'n kraan' can attach to 'stad' and 'sonder ... en plase' can read as 'without a tap and without farms'; two short clauses remove both misreadings with the same word count and meaning.

vlae.teks: Sonder skoon water of sonder mediese hulp word mense makliker siek.
vlae.rede: 'mediese hulp' seems to stand for the protected video term 'gesondheidsorg' taught two blocks earlier; if it means the same thing, a learner gets two words for one idea. Not changed, because whether it is meant to be narrower is a content question.
